decisions.rationale: First project reached day 0 (2026-08-06) but no key milestone and no invite by day 6; 8 days left. Customer never replied to check-in [email:edbe7c22]; ticket thread was closed by support without customer confirmation [email:ec4406fc], and a usability blocker plus silence suggests low unaided momentum.

draft.subject: Following up on your Granite Systems setup
draft.body:
Hi Aisha,

Thanks for flagging the mobile save button — support marked that thread closed on our side, so please tell me if anything still looks off and I'll pick it straight back up.

With your first project in place, the next step that usually makes Wrenfield click is getting a teammate in alongside you. A teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through whatever's next with you.

Best,
Chidi
